lines.en: I walk the village with a spear
My stride is steadier than any

lines.zh: 我绕过村子中央的火坑
lines.en: I skirt the central fire pit
My goblins clear a path
I step over broken timber
I tap the spear on the ground
I head toward the palisade
My shadow slides over the roofs
I walk deeper into the village
My plates knock against each other
I sit on the largest crate
I wipe the spear tip with cloth
My goblins keep their distance
I count the huts
I look up at the banner pole
I knock on my own plate
I do not sit long

lines.zh: 我盯着火堆里的一块炭
lines.en: I stare at a coal in the fire
I hold the spear upright
I push my helmet up
I sweep a slow look around
I spit on the ground
I wait for someone to report
I retie my belt
My ears keep flicking
I plant a foot on the crate
I turn the spear point at you
The village has gone still
I stand shorter than you

lines.zh: 你身上没有哥布林的味道
lines.en: You do not smell of goblin
My goblins clear the way
This village is mine
Leave your weapon at the gate
My crown's crooked, and I leave it.
Say plainly what you want
There is something else in your eyes
I let out a slow breath
I hold my footing
A white mark shows on my plate
I spit out blood
That stoked my anger
I wipe my face with a hand
I still stand
I cough once and straighten up.
I grip the spear harder
My goblins are watching
You may present it to me
I look at it and do not take it
That does not move me
My goblins eat first
Coins would be more useful
I turn it over with my hand
You have not brought enough
I do not lack this mouthful
Put it away, let us talk
You hit my shoulder
I do not budge a hair
You are thrown back
My plate is the thickest here
My goblins shout behind me
I press one step in
Bump me? Ask my shield first.

lines.zh: 首领的肩膀，可不是给你撞的。
lines.en: The chief's shoulder isn't yours to ram.
I arrange the village's affairs
These things follow rules
I acknowledge only the strongest

lines.zh: 现在不是谈这个的时候
lines.en: This is not the time to speak of it
I have more pressing matters
Do not bother me with this
My goblins still need orders
First keep the village
Save that for after the fight
I will settle this business first
I bend and take it up
I weigh it in my hand
This belongs to the village
I toss it to one of mine
I look and keep it
This one I keep for myself
Useless, throw it away
I stuff it in the pack
I am not quite satisfied with it
I wave for it to be taken away
You stand in the middle of my village
I have raised the spear
All of you stand aside
I lift the spear point
Remember my smell
You stand before my fire pit
I take a long step in
Not one of my goblins moves
I open this fight
I bang my plates
I fix on your waist
The timber wall is behind you
Let me see how long you last
Leave, or you lie down
This distance means nothing

lines.zh: 我把矛尖对准你的心口
lines.en: I level my point at your heart
The villagers back to the walls
I hold nothing back this time
I move around the fire pit
I bring the spear across
You are hunting an opening
My goblins block the gate
I wait for you to lunge
Your hand is reaching to your belt
I drop the spear point
The tip of my spear rides low.
I step on coals and do not flinch
I know every inch of this village
You are at the fire pit's edge
I will strike in a moment
All my goblins are watching
Your feet are in the ash
I raise the spear higher
You can hear my plates
I never miss the first one
These are all my goblins
Barrels block your retreat
My spear point goes in
I sweep the spear across
I drop low and thrust
The spear haft hits your shoulder
I raise the shield to catch your swing
I stab again from behind the shield
I knock you into a barrel

lines.zh: 我的矛尖划开你的袖子
lines.en: My point opens your sleeve
I take a step to your flank
This thrust carries my weight
You blocked that one too
I turn the spear about
You are forced to the wall
I thrust twice in a row

lines.zh: 村子中央的火烧得更旺
lines.en: The central fire burns higher
I come out of the great hut
My goblins fall back on both sides
I plant the spear butt on the ground
A shout goes up at the gate
I stride to the fire pit
Firelight rolls over my plates

lines.zh: 我的影子压住一片木屋
lines.en: My shadow covers several huts
I pull the banner taut
The whole village has come out
I take the spear down from its rack
Someone blows a bone whistle
I walk from shadow into firelight
My goblins open a lane for me

lines.zh: 村子中央的旗升了起来
lines.en: The banner rises over the village
I pull my helmet down
The mud packs under my feet
I raise a hand and the shouting stops
Firelight finds my face
This is where I stand up
Fire scorches the skin on my shoulder
I land and my legs go numb
My spear sinks to the bottom.
The blast throws me by the fire pit
An arrow lodges in my plate seam
Magic burns my helmet
I have not had my first bite

lines.zh: 雷击让我整条手臂发沉
lines.en: The strike makes my whole arm heavy
I fall with my spear still up
